nodes.result_note: PPSW2-6 (s=6, local order exactly 5) matrices derived from printed c,gamma0,gamma1 (APNUM 2004 p.432), 3 independent routes agree ~1e-79, order residuals <=1e-77, B(1) strongly stable, alpha~81.6deg, stiffly accurate, same-step stage independence. NOT qualified for G0: global order 5 not measured, step-ratio domain narrow (alpha=32.7deg at sigma=1.2, 0 at 1.5; sigma_max=1.2 source figures unread), starting values for c<0 nodes UNRESOLVED, coefficient-precision policy is an owner decision; PPSW2-5 (APNUM gamma row) CONTRADICTS_SOURCE (zero-unstable). PW04/PW06 stay gated. PW03B (2026-11-11): CANDIDATE_FOR_PW04 (conditional), all 6 G0 gates NOT_RUN. Variable-step zero-stability: alternating h, r*h diverges for r>=1.19 (r=1.2: two-step rho^(1/2)=1.0105, mpmath 50 digits) => usable sigma_max <= ~1.15 (NUMERICALLY_CHECKED, not proven; no proven interval in literature). Starter for c<0 nodes not printed (ROWMAP/RODAS used in papers). Prototype on synthetic problems with exact starter: Prothero-Robinson lam=-1 observed order 4.89->4.99 (coordinator rerun of z6 reproduced all error values bitwise); starter error h^3 degrades to 3.4-3.9. T=0.6J diverges (W-tolerance is limited; may conflict with the 'fast lane zero explicit-J' target). No other fully parallel p>=5 Peer-W with printed tableau found; BIT 'mipeer6' is a formula-based reconstruction (order 6.01 in prototype; s=5 g0 inconsistent with table).

terminology: JVP is derivative action, not derivative-free
FD-JVP is approximate derivative action, incurs extra RHS and perturbation error
matrix-free does not mean solve-free or preconditioner-free
Newton-free does not imply globally convergent or root-certified
stage-parallel means independent current-step method stages proven from exact tableau; spatial/ensemble/RHS-row parallelism are separate axes
RODAS5P has eight strictly causal lower-triangular stages
common W/factor reuse does not remove stage dependencies
PTSW2C is order 3 A(81.1-degree) candidate, not L-stable
PTSW2B is distinct order-2 L-stable control
BDF/Radau are reference-only in pinned source
a method family theorem does not certify an unverified coefficient table
sampled output error is not a continuous-time/global error enclosure
negative_evidence_must_survive: R7 transactional vs protected full-IVP negative result
C5 graph-Schur median wall ratio 2.242032452000776, all 12 original test pairs slower
C5 path length one/zero physical affine compositions
R9 ring24 core size one but long DAG path witness
R10 scan is ordered affine recurrence, not causal IVP parallelism
PP05 G2/G3 fail, PP06 harmful alias gate fail, PP15 no timing
PW07 CPU overlap 1.489x is synthetic operator-action microbenchmark only; prior 1.781x run indicates variability
